dedupe_keys.name: water use efficiency data from 2000 to 2019 in measuring progress towards sdgs in central asia

description: Chen and colleagues publish summer water-use efficiency rasters for five Central Asian countries from 2000 to 2019, plus country-scale water use per 10,000 US dollars of GDP for 1997 to 2017. Science Data Bank lists the dataset as PUBLIC under CC BY 4.0, with 89 files totalling 2.05 GB. Its description says each annual summer raster is 500 m, with a year in the TIFF filename. The country indicators include all sectors; the rasters focus on agricultural water use. This can help irrigation or water-supply simulations compare historical efficiency patterns and set regional demand assumptions. It does not provide pipe capacities, withdrawal points or measured network flows. The 500 m raster and national economic statistic are different scales and should not be treated as interchangeable. The paper and repository describe an SDG 6.4.1 use, while a modeller would need to check definitions and units before using it as an operational constraint. No file was downloaded, so individual raster values and country-table columns were not verified. Related water datasets can supply hydrology, but this release measures efficiency.
